score_definition: raw (0-1) scores of IFEval, BBH, MATH Lvl 5, GPQA, MUSR, MMLU-PRO; rows with any missing/non-finite raw score dropped; duplicate normalized fullname -> latest Submission Date (ties eval_name)
normalization: fullname NFKC lowercase; family = Base Model column (normalized) else fullname; content hash = sha256 canonical JSON of the 6 raw scores rounded to 6 decimals; union-find over base model, normalized name and content hash; groups hash-assigned; held-out = first groups in hash order until >=25% of rows, then capped at 300 rows by row-hash order (surplus held-out rows dropped, not moved to history)
